name: @open-neko/plugin-magic-link
description: Passwordless email sign-in for OpenNeko. Implements the auth contract with manual provisioning: an admin creates each user (email and role) in OpenNeko first, and only those users can request a single-use, HMAC-signed sign-in link. Holding a mailbox never mints an account. Delivery via Resend, Postmark, or SendGrid.

env.description: HMAC key that signs each sign-in token. The host generates and stores it for you, and never shows it. Delete the stored value and restart to rotate it, which invalidates every outstanding link.
From address for the sign-in email, e.g. "OpenNeko <signin@company.com>". Must be a sender verified with your email provider.
Resend API key. Set exactly one of RESEND_API_KEY, POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN, or SENDGRID_API_KEY. The key you set selects the delivery provider.
Postmark server token. Set exactly one of RESEND_API_KEY, POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN, or SENDGRID_API_KEY.
SendGrid API key. Set exactly one of RESEND_API_KEY, POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN, or SENDGRID_API_KEY.
Sign-in link lifetime in seconds, 60 to 600. The default is 600, which is 10 minutes. The state cookie expires then anyway, so a longer value buys nothing.
